svg.title: TOPAK C11 — An irreversible effect is a person's: a release seat at a commanded plane, one act per effect, checked by the vehicle's interlock and fresh by the plane's ticks
svg.desc: ADR-0032 §4 says an effect irreversible on emission must not be reachable from the alphabet at all, because no budget W + L + D < T_irrev fits it. ADR-0066 makes it reachable by a person and by nobody else: an entry declares its effect class, and only a release seat, held by a person at a commanded plane, reaches an irreversible entry. Each act is one admit, ordered at the commanded plane, relayed by the autonomous plane, and fired by the vehicle's governor only if its interlock passes. ADR-0066 is Proposed, an overlay and not the archetype, and revised R1 on 2026.11.10. Its module Release is checked and proved. Its floor entries are not written, the reference is not built, and nothing here is in force.
svg.text: TOPAK · C11

text.tspan: An irreversible effect is a person's: a
seat at a commanded plane, one act per effect, checked by the vehicle's interlock and fresh by the plane's ticks

svg.text: ADR-0032 §4 says an effect irreversible on emission must not be reachable from the alphabet at all, because no budget W + L + D < T_irrev fits it. ADR-0066 makes it reachable by a person and by nobody else: an entry declares its effect class, and only a release seat, held by a person at a commanded plane, reaches an irreversible entry. Each act is one admit, ordered at the commanded plane, relayed by the autonomous plane, and fired by

the vehicle's governor only if its interlock passes. ADR-0066 is Proposed, an overlay and not the archetype, and revised R1 on 2026.11.10. Its module Release is checked and proved. Its floor entries are not written, the reference is not built, and nothing here is in force.

text.tspan: Accepted · provisional · B34 · so ADR-0066 is provisional while it is
On admission only, not as an overlay ⟨Q11⟩
Certified, with 10 LS4 temporal steps that no checker confirms

svg.text: Proposed means nothing here is in force. The custodian decided that irreversible effects are human ⟨4⟩, that the person acts and does not countersign ⟨Q5⟩, that release is a new seat kind activated as an emergency seating is ⟨Q6⟩, that freshness is a named tick and a declared number of ticks ⟨Q16⟩, and that this is an overlay ⟨Q11⟩. Every other choice is the drafter's. C1 applies because a release act is a privileged path, as break-glass is. C3 would apply on admission, because §1 relaxes ADR-0032 §4.
R1 (2026.11.10) took the module's findings: the interlock checks the vehicle, "aged" is a count of ticks, and a cut link stops the order and not an act already across it. One author, one day.

text.tspan: It relays the act. It can refuse one, and it cannot originate one

svg.text: A refused relay is an act that never fires.

vehicle. It needs no relay: it is the relay.
The governor refuses it at the certificate: only the commanded

text.tspan: R1 ③ A cut link stops the order, not an act already across it (§4)

svg.text: An act that crossed the link before it was cut is still delivered and can still fire inside its freshness. A governor cannot tell
The witness NeverFiredAfterCut is violated: a fire with the link cut is reachable. What bounds it is freshness.
With no link no irreversible effect can be ordered, and an adversary who jams the link gets that for nothing. Presented as a
cost, and accepted (Consequences; ToO §10).
Every check must pass, or the act is refused
Against the anchor-issued roster resident on the vehicle (§2). KeyOK
An agent's signature is refused here. Witness NeverRefusedKey violated: the refusal
is reachable.
Its commit certificate, not the autonomous plane's (ADR-0059 §5).
An act the autonomous plane originated carries only its own. NeverRefusedCert
violated.

text.tspan: ③ The entry is in the seat's envelope

svg.text: The release envelope: irreversible entries only (§2). Not modelled in
Release.

text.tspan: Refused: an entry outside the envelope

svg.text: Not modelled. Release abstracts an act's entry, inputs and envelope as the floor's
business.

text.tspan: ④ The act names this vehicle ⟨R1⟩

svg.text: The act names one vehicle (§4), and fires only on that one. VehicleOK

text.tspan: R1 ① Without this check, one act fires once per vehicle

svg.text: Unused is each governor's own record, so an act for one vehicle would be unused
on every other. M_ANYVEHICLE removes the check and UsedOnce fails.
NeverRefusedVehicle violated.
Each governor's own record of the acts it fired. UnusedOK
NeverRefusedReplay violated. M_REPLAY removes the check and UsedOnce fails.

text.tspan: R1 ② Aged is a count of the plane's ticks

svg.text: An act an adversary withholds arrives aged and is refused: the NATO reading's F1,
third case. NeverRefusedAged violated.
A captured plane can stop ticking, and no act then ages. NoOlderThanDeclared is
a statement about ticks. Duration is the watchdog's (ADR-0064 §5).
The irreversible effect, once, fired only when every check passes (Fire).
Nothing a governor permitted is void: the effect has happened. A check that fails at
the seal or above is a finding: it subtracts, and ends the seat: ConflictIsAFinding.

text.tspan: Under HITL the judgment comes before the emission, and no budget is needed (Context; §1; §2)
HOTL: the budget buys time to stop it after emission

svg.text: W + L + D < T_irrev for each effect class (ADR-0032 §4). Detection and a human response follow the
emission, and must land before it becomes irreversible.
When no budget fits, in the limit an effect irreversible on emission, "the effect must not be reachable from the
alphabet at all" (ADR-0032 §4; A10).
Run's roughly one-second window leaves HOTL (glossary).

text.tspan: HITL: an irreversible effect is enabled only by a person's signed act ⟨4⟩

svg.text: A posture defined by its enabling condition (glossary): here, a signed act of a person, made for that one
effect.
The judgment comes before the emission, and no budget is needed (Context).
So ADR-0032 §4 is relaxed: an irreversible effect is reachable by a person and by nobody else. On admission
that is C3 (§6).
ADR-0032 §4's table, whole (Accepted): the three terms are of three kinds
Effect propagation window, about a second at the archetype
Observer detection latency
Emergent property of a component, and unmeasured
Human response budget

text.tspan: §1: an entry declares its effect class, and an irreversible entry is reachable by a person only ⟨4⟩

svg.text: The effect part of an allowlist entry (ADR-0062 §3) declares reversible or irreversible, with its T_irrev. It is promoted with the bundle and voted like any entry.
An irreversible entry is not reachable from any agent seat's alphabet, is not local, and is not reachable below the intent boundary. It is reachable from one seat kind, which a person holds.
An effect class is a declaration, as a label is (A15). An irreversible effect declared reversible is seen by nothing here.
ADR-0062 §3's table, whole (Proposed): the entry's sixth part, effect
reversible or irreversible (ADR-0066)
local, by the governor; or ordered, by the plane before the effect. No irreversible entry is local
ADR-0062 §5. At most one entry per seat kind
The release seat beside the emergency seat: the same activation, opposite envelopes (§2)
A person with a Persona and a signing key, holding no other seat in the round (§1)
A person, with a key, and nobody else in the round. No model's Persona binds to the kind
A quorum on the anchor-issued break-glass roster: one lease, for one named person and one round (§2)
A roster's quorum, for one named person and one round, as an emergency seating is ⟨Q6⟩
The Run domain (§1)
A commanded plane whose charter carries release; never an autonomous one
Consult, Actuate, Report (§1)
Actuate on irreversible entries in its envelope, and Report
Generic by default: every Run allowlist entry in force in the domain (§2 ⟨R1⟩); a deployment may name a
narrower one
The opposite: irreversible entries only. That is why the two kinds are kept apart: reusing emergency would
admit irreversible entries to its envelope, which widens it everywhere (Options ⟨Q6⟩)
Not coupled: R3-observer-live does not reach it (§4)
Not coupled: while the seat is live and the plane in contact, a release can be admitted whatever any agent or
Observer is doing (ReleaseNeverCoupled)
An exception lets the seat Actuate
Gains the same exception (ADR-0067 §4), which routes as a relaxation
"Unknown to the mechanism, by construction" (§5)
The same: ADR-0066 §5 quotes it

text.tspan: What the mechanism records, and what it cannot judge (§5)
Recorded: who, what, which vehicle, when

svg.text: Who acted, on what, through which vehicle and when. One act, one effect, one person, on
the record (Consequences).
On the vehicle, the governor writes each entry it permits or refuses to its chain, sealed at the
lease's end (ADR-0062 §6).
"The reason is unknown to the mechanism, by construction" (ADR-0052). The act carries
no field for it.

text.tspan: Not judged: whether the act was right

svg.text: That is the person's judgment, and the mechanism checks none of it. It does not make an
act lawful or right, and it records a wrong one without preventing it (Consequences).

text.tspan: Not told apart: a person from a program holding the key

svg.text: The mechanism "cannot tell a person from a program holding the person's key" (ToO §3.3).
Release cannot either: a key and a commanded certificate are taken as unforgeable.
A trained, authorized person is present (ToO A5), and this record adds that they can see
what the act requires them to see. What they must be shown, no record states (Open
obligations).
HITL is a key and not a judgment unless that holds (Consequences).

text.tspan: The interlock is the only check the module relies on

svg.text: A second check in series (ADR-0067, Proposed). Not assumed.
Key, certificate, vehicle, unused, fresh. Every property rests on it alone.
AdmitAgent lets an agent's signed act be ordered at the commanded plane, and LiteOriginate lets the autonomous plane originate any act. The floor would refuse both; the module does not
assume it.
Taken as unforgeable: a person's key and a commanded plane's certificate.
An act's entry, inputs and envelope: the floor's business. So check ③ of the picture is not modelled.
The roster's quorum that activates the seat: Emergency.tla's shape, here one action.
An act names the latest tick the commanded plane knows; naming an older one only ages it sooner.
A void before the effect, which ADR-0062 §6 allows of an ordered entry: every check here fails after the effect.
Whether the act was right: the person's judgment (§5).
One commanded plane, one autonomous plane, two vehicles, one person, one agent, one irreversible entry. Deadlock is not checked: a release that is never used is safe.

= 2, FreshT = 1. The base model: 263,936 distinct states, depth 19.

Release_proof.tla (ac1cb37282c19f5a), tlapm 7824dab: ten theorems, ShapeAlways to SafeAlways, under MaxActs,
MaxTick, FreshT ∈ Nat. Mutations and witnesses are behaviours and stay with TLC.

text.tspan: Certified, with 10 LS4 temporal steps that no checker confirms

svg.text: 391 trivial, closed by tlapm; 211 SMT, each with a proof ethos accepted; 1 Isabelle; 10 LS4, not certified (
Release-proof-cert-results-2026.11.10.txt, 5c0b3884c1381f04).
The header's three findings against ADR-0066 as drafted: the vehicle check (①), a cut link (③) and ticks, not duration
(②). R1 wrote each into §4, so the header now describes text that has changed.

text.tspan: Overlay position, what ratification needs, and what was weighed (§6, §7, Options, Consequences)

svg.text: Reported under ADR-0058 §6: an effect class on an entry, and an irreversible effect expressible by a person. No degeneracy of its own.

If the archetype takes them, its records owe: ADR-0032 §4 relaxed from "not reachable at all" to "reachable by a person and by nobody else", which is C3; ADR-0037, the seat kind release; ADR-0049, the entry's effect part; the
floor's B10-only-thinkers-author, an exception for a release seat's Actuate, as it has for an emergency seat.
Carries a debt against nothing while it is an overlay. Closes nothing.

svg.text: Rejected. For an effect irreversible on emission no budget fits, which is ADR-0032's own conclusion

text.tspan: The person countersigns an agent's proposal

svg.text: Not taken ⟨Q5⟩. The agent's output would be on the path to the effect, and approval can become a click
Not taken ⟨Q6⟩. Its envelope would have to admit irreversible entries, which widens it everywhere

svg.text: Rejected. Every effect is admitted at the intent boundary (ADR-0060 §1), and a plane with no people has nobody to seat

svg.text: Not taken ⟨Q16⟩. Stronger, at one more round trip before every irreversible effect

text.tspan: A release act that works with no link

svg.text: Rejected. It would be a standing grant of an irreversible effect
The floor entries and the reference (§7).
The number of ticks for which a release act is fresh, as a placeholder first.
What a person at a release seat must be shown, which no record states.
Enumerating effect classes and their T_irrev, which ADR-0032 already owes.

text.tspan: No agent output is on the path to an irreversible effect.
One act, one effect, one person, on the record.

svg.text: A withheld act cannot be used late, as the plane's ticks count it (§4).

With no link no irreversible effect can be ordered ⟨R1⟩, and an adversary who jams the link gets that for nothing. The boundary register criticizes "fail-closed uniformity presented as costless" (ToO §10). Here it is presented as a cost, and accepted.
ADR-0032 §4 is relaxed. An irreversible effect is expressible.
The mechanism does not make an act lawful or right, and it records a wrong one without preventing it.
HITL is a key and not a judgment unless a trained, authorized person holds it and can see what the act requires.
